name: voidcorp
description: VoidCorp craftsman harness — universal core skills plus stack-specific packs. Self-hosted: every plugin is a subdirectory of this repo, versioned by its plugin.json.

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Universal craftsman skills (TDD strict, TypeScript strict, hexagonal, DDD, functional, code-review, security) plus enforcement hooks and read-only agents.

plugins.name: harness-monorepo
plugins.description: Turborepo monorepo conventions: shared strict tsconfig, @repo/core (Result, Option, pipe), package boundary discipline.

plugins.name: harness-react
plugins.description: React 19 conventions: shadcn/Radix, accessibility-first, client/server component boundaries, form and state patterns.

plugins.name: harness-nextjs
plugins.description: Next.js 16 App Router conventions: route groups, cache components, loading/error boundaries, instrumentation.

plugins.name: harness-server
plugins.description: Server-side trust boundaries: Server Actions, webhook safety, Zod ingress, rate limiting, Drizzle migrations, structured errors.

plugins.name: harness-pwa
plugins.description: PWA conventions: manifest, service worker, offline-first strategies.

plugins.name: harness-mobile
plugins.description: Mobile conventions: Expo + React Native, EAS Build, config plugins, OTA update strategy. Composes with harness-react.
